Definition: of Hebrew origin (H223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite:--Urias.
BiblicalUsage: Uriah the Hittite is named in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus, as the husband of Bathsheba, the woman David took after Uriah was slain in battle. He was a Hittite who served David faithfully, and his death is the darkest mark on David's reign.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Uriah's name in the genealogy is the confession of the whole Bible: David's sin is not hidden, and the grace that covers it is not hidden either.
